header:
Chinese University of Hong Kong
Hong Kong SAR, China · Mathematics articulated MPhil-PhD: MPhil or direct PhD stream
Canadian/Asian selection; not a US News graduate rank.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• HKPFS has a noon RGC deadline and a separate 23:59 CUHK deadline on 1 December 2026.
• Prepare three PhD letters despite the stale Mathematics page saying two.
• The Math GRE can be required case by case; UChicago status is not an advertised exemption.
• Obtain an English-medium Registrar letter and clarify qualification verification early.
• Do not count a self-financed admission as a funded offer, or a four-year scholarship package as annual
income.
• Public Mathematics essay prompts and precise referee mechanics remain inaccessible; the dossier preserves
these gaps explicitly.
• Do not choose Jiu-Kang Yu or Xuhua He as current ordinary CUHK advisers from stale pages.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can support application to either stream of this articulated MPhil-PhD,
subject to CUHK equivalence and academic review. The bachelor’s route normally requires honours at least
Second Class, or an honours programme averaging at least B; do not apply the separate standalone-PhD
master’s requirement to Mathematics. Final-year students can apply before graduating. Mathematics or a
related major is expected and an interview may be required. Nonlocal applicants follow the same academic
process; U.S. F-1 status does not substitute for Hong Kong student immigration permission. GPA and
completion date remain unverified. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s15]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select MPhil versus PhD stream and intended mathematical area; verify degree equivalence, prepare official
transcript scans and grading legend, obtain a UChicago Registrar English-medium letter, and ask academic
referees in advance. Public rules do not establish a mandatory prior supervisor agreement. For HKPFS first
obtain the RGC reference number, then submit CUHK’s separate full application and any HKPFS supplement.
RGC permits two ranked programme choices; priority changes stop at its initial deadline. Submit early enough
to activate referees after submission. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s9] [s10] [s13] [s17]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No mandatory prior supervisor agreement is stated. Contacting faculty about research fit is sensible; the
Graduate Panel ultimately appoints the supervisor and may take applicant preferences into account.
Admissions contact: rpg.math@cuhk.edu.hk (graduate programme listing names Prof. De-Jun Feng). The
eight-person shortlist below includes adjacent symplectic/Poisson/gauge work but is not a claim that every
listed person is accepting students. Stale department pages retain moved and emeritus people; verify
appointment and capacity directly. [s1] [s13] [s19]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use the Graduate School Online Application System; the public login warns against multiple accounts. Apply,
pay, complete required supporting uploads and arrange referee reports; check the portal and email for
decisions. Only public pages were inspected: no account was created and no referee invitation sent.

Screen-only prompts, reference status indicators and editing options are consequently unresolved. [s3] [s4] [s5]
[s18]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
The central Mathematics programme and HKPFS pages explicitly identify 2027/28 deadlines and fees. Regular
studentship amounts are still labelled 2026/27; the research code is dated October 2025. Several departmental
admissions pages are visibly stale and repeatedly failed direct opening, although official indexed extracts were
available. Current central pages control where their dating resolves the conflict. [s1] [s6] [s7] [s9] [s13] [s15] [s16]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
2027/28 main round: 1 December 2026. Clearing round: 31 March 2027, subject to places remaining. The
mathematics listing does not specify a clock time for ordinary main/clearing applications; CUHK’s HKPFS full
application explicitly closes 1 December 2026 at 23:59 Hong Kong time. Application opens 1 September 2026.
[s1] [s4] [s9]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
HKPFS has two different 1 December 2026 deadlines: RGC initial application at 12:00 noon Hong Kong time and
complete CUHK application at 23:59 Hong Kong time. Ordinary PGS consideration is automatic with a qualifying
full-time research application; no separate public Mathematics PGS deadline was found. Vice-Chancellor’s
award uses the department application deadline, so use the main round for fullest consideration rather than
assuming clearing retains equivalent funding. [s1] [s5] [s8] [s9] [s10]
Reference receipt [Unresolved]
No separate current Mathematics reference deadline or grace period was verified. Central instructions require
supporting documents by the programme deadline: plan completed letters by 1 December 2026 for the
main/HKPFS round (CUHK HKPFS deadline 23:59 HKT), or 31 March 2027 clearing if applicable. Since the
documented workflow activates referees only after submission, do not submit at the last minute. Obtain
written Mathematics confirmation of the actual reference cut-off; grace periods published by other CUHK
departments or CUHK Shenzhen are not transferable. [s1] [s3] [s4] [s9] [s17]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
English evidence, or the Registrar English-medium certification alternative, belongs with supporting documents
by the relevant programme deadline. If Mathematics requests a GRE Subject test in an individual case, ask for
its exact receipt deadline. No independent score grace period or later universal deadline is public. Any
conditional offer will separately prescribe final evidence deadlines. [s1] [s3] [s4] [s5]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Supporting application documents are due by the programme deadline; final-year applicants provide latest
official transcripts initially and final graduation documents later under offer conditions. For qualifications
earned outside Hong Kong/mainland China, the central page requires positive qualification-verification results
no later than one month before programme commencement. The precise verification provider/process is
communicated by the programme; do not assume a UChicago degree requires a particular mainland
verification service. [s3] [s4] [s5]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
No common public Mathematics commitment date was found. The individual offer/payment advice gives the
acceptance and deposit deadline. Acceptance requires the prescribed deposit; it is not refundable or
transferable between programmes. Only one CUHK offer may be accepted at a time. An extension needs
Graduate Division approval and cannot run beyond programme commencement. [s4] [s5]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
A degree taught in English satisfies the general English requirement. Otherwise current listed alternatives
include TOEFL iBT 79/120 or 4.5/6, IELTS Academic 6.5, or specified GMAT verbal scores. TOEFL Home Edition
and IELTS Online are listed as accepted; scores are normally valid two years (GMAT five). The FAQ rejects
TOEFL MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake. Programme-specific additional requirements take precedence. [s2]
[s5]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Likely satisfied through UChicago’s English-medium bachelor’s, conditional on the degree and documentation:
central instructions require a Registry certifying letter confirming English as the programme’s medium. Obtain
that letter rather than relying only on U.S. location or F-1 status. The older Mathematics page uses a narrower
native-English-country formulation; current Graduate School documentation is clearer and should control,
subject to confirmation in the application. [s2] [s3] [s15]
GRE General [Unresolved]
No General GRE requirement is listed in the current Mathematics programme or general graduate
requirements. Public evidence does not establish whether an unsolicited General GRE is ignored, accepted, or
considered; do not label it prohibited. [s1] [s2] [s15]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
The current Mathematics programme explicitly says the GRE Subject Test in Mathematics may be required in
some cases. It gives neither a universal requirement nor an exemption for UChicago graduates, and no score
minimum. Ask rpg.math@cuhk.edu.hk whether your application will require it before relying on an untested
application. [s1]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload copies of official tertiary transcripts bearing the institution’s seal, with grading scheme/explanatory
notes; student-portal unofficial grade printouts are not the stated substitute. Include graduation/professional
certificates if already awarded, identity/passport evidence, and the qualification-verification authorization
requested centrally. Chinese or English records are accepted; other languages need certified English
translation. Final official documents are verified after an offer through direct institutional e-transcripts or
sealed institutional envelopes. Mainland qualifications have additional CHESICC/CHSI requirements if
applicable to any of your records. [s3] [s5] [s15]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Conflict]
Current Graduate School checklist: three referees for research doctoral applications, two for other applications
(therefore three for Mathematics PhD and two for MPhil). The older Mathematics page still says two, creating a
conflict; prepare three for the doctoral stream and confirm the portal’s actual requirement. [s3] [s15]

Scholarship references [Unresolved]
HKPFS should use academic referees, as the Graduate School’s November 2025 archived instructions specify;
academic/professional institutional email and letterhead are requested there. No fourth or additional
scholarship referee was identified in current public CUHK material. Exact 2027 HKPFS referee questions, and
whether the portal reuses the ordinary three reports, remain unverified. [s3] [s9] [s16] [s17]
What sends the invitation [Prior cycle]
The central November 2025 archived instructions describe entering referee details after successful submission,
followed by University email invitations. The older Mathematics HKPFS page describes the same
post-submission process. These support a likely common workflow, but the current public login does not
expose the 2027 referee screen; confirm before assuming that saving names in a draft immediately sends
anything. [s16] [s17] [s18]
Before versus after submission [Prior cycle]
Yes in the publicly documented prior-cycle workflow: successful application submission precedes referee
entry/invitation. Current 2027 screen-level verification is unavailable without creating an application, which
was not done. [s16] [s17] [s18]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
The central application system provides overall application-status checking, but a Mathematics-specific referee
receipt/checkmark, applicant email notification, and referee submission acknowledgement were not publicly
verified. Ask the programme how to verify all reports are received; an invitation is not proof of receipt. [s4] [s5]
[s18]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
No current Mathematics rule was found for replacing a referee, editing a submitted letter, reusing a report
across programmes or cycles, or allowing updates after the deadline. Other divisions publish their own
restrictions; they cannot safely be generalized. Obtain programme instructions before requesting an
updated/reused report. [s3] [s5] [s18]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Regular PGS: published 2026/27 annual amount HK$229,200; no 2027/28 regular rate is confirmed. It is
financial assistance, not a quoted net-after-tuition salary. 2027/28 tuition is HK$49,500 annually unless
separately waived. HKPFS 2027/28: HK$344,400 annual stipend plus HK$14,400 annual research-travel
allowance; CUHK additionally lists tuition waiver, lodging award HK$40,000 first year/HK$20,000 subsequent
years, and first-year hostel-fee waiver. Published maximum package exceeds HK$1.81m over four years, not
per year. Health/other fee coverage is not fully specified. [s6] [s7] [s9] [s13]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Full-time MPhil normative duration is two years; direct PhD without a research master’s is four years, versus

three with one. Regular PGS is awarded within the normative period, subject to the individual offer. CUHK’s
HKPFS package is published for the normative period up to four years, including University support beyond the
RGC’s three-year component. Guaranteed on-campus accommodation requires timely hall
application/registration; only first-year hostel fees are expressly waived. [s7] [s9] [s10] [s12]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Nonlocal applicants can receive PGS, Vice-Chancellor and HKPFS awards. HKPFS is open regardless of
nationality; F-1 is not a nationality. The government local-student research tuition-waiver scheme is not
automatically available to an international applicant. Belt and Road awards depend on qualifying
citizenship/region, which is unknown here. [s7] [s9] [s10] [s14]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PGS is competitive, announced with the offer and can be absent from a self-financed full-time admission. The
October 2025 code permits teaching/research duties averaging at most 12 hours weekly and
suspension/curtailment for unsatisfactory progress or duties. Hong Kong residence is generally required unless
absence is approved. Without a research master’s, PGS can suspend after month 24 if candidacy is unpassed;
Mathematics separately expects the candidacy examination within the first 12 months. Current offer terms,
training, employment restrictions and renewal govern. [s1] [s5] [s7] [s13]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can support application to either stream of this articulated MPhil-PhD,
subject to CUHK equivalence and academic review. The bachelor’s route normally requires honours at least
Second Class, or an honours programme averaging at least B; do not apply the separate standalone-PhD
master’s requirement to Mathematics. Final-year students can apply before graduating. Mathematics or a
related major is expected and an interview may be required. Nonlocal applicants follow the same academic
process; U.S. F-1 status does not substitute for Hong Kong student immigration permission. GPA and
completion date remain unverified. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s15]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select MPhil versus PhD stream and intended mathematical area; verify degree equivalence, prepare official
transcript scans and grading legend, obtain a UChicago Registrar English-medium letter, and ask academic
referees in advance. Public rules do not establish a mandatory prior supervisor agreement. For HKPFS first
obtain the RGC reference number, then submit CUHK’s separate full application and any HKPFS supplement.
RGC permits two ranked programme choices; priority changes stop at its initial deadline. Submit early enough
to activate referees after submission. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s9] [s10] [s13] [s17]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No mandatory prior supervisor agreement is stated. Contacting faculty about research fit is sensible; the
Graduate Panel ultimately appoints the supervisor and may take applicant preferences into account.
Admissions contact: rpg.math@cuhk.edu.hk (graduate programme listing names Prof. De-Jun Feng). The
eight-person shortlist below includes adjacent symplectic/Poisson/gauge work but is not a claim that every
listed person is accepting students. Stale department pages retain moved and emeritus people; verify
appointment and capacity directly. [s1] [s13] [s19]

Use the Graduate School Online Application System; the public login warns against multiple accounts. Apply,
pay, complete required supporting uploads and arrange referee reports; check the portal and email for
decisions. Only public pages were inspected: no account was created and no referee invitation sent.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can support application to either stream of this articulated MPhil-PhD,
subject to CUHK equivalence and academic review. The bachelor’s route normally requires honours at least
Second Class, or an honours programme averaging at least B; do not apply the separate standalone-PhD
master’s requirement to Mathematics. Final-year students can apply before graduating. Mathematics or a
related major is expected and an interview may be required. Nonlocal applicants follow the same academic
process; U.S. F-1 status does not substitute for Hong Kong student immigration permission. GPA and
completion date remain unverified. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s15]

Select MPhil versus PhD stream and intended mathematical area; verify degree equivalence, prepare official
transcript scans and grading legend, obtain a UChicago Registrar English-medium letter, and ask academic
referees in advance. Public rules do not establish a mandatory prior supervisor agreement. For HKPFS first
obtain the RGC reference number, then submit CUHK’s separate full application and any HKPFS supplement.
RGC permits two ranked programme choices; priority changes stop at its initial deadline. Submit early enough
to activate referees after submission. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s9] [s10] [s13] [s17]

appointment and capacity directly. [s1] [s13] [s19]
